description:
Estimate a match's expected goals and win/draw/loss probabilities.

Args:
    home_team: First team, FIFA code or name (e.g. "ARG" or "Argentina").
    away_team: Second team, FIFA code or name (e.g. "BRA" or "Brazil").
    neutral: True for a neutral venue (no home advantage). World Cup default.

Returns:
    data: {expected_home_goals, expected_away_goals, home_win, draw, away_win}.
    meta.estimated: true.

away_team.description: Second team, FIFA code or name (e.g. "BRA" or "Brazil").
away_team.title: Away Team

home_team.description: First team, FIFA code or name (e.g. "ARG" or "Argentina").
home_team.title: Home Team

neutral.description: True for a neutral venue (no home advantage). World Cup default.
neutral.title: Neutral

name: football_xg_model
